cards.name: vehicles-card
cards.title: Vehicles
cards.template: <> <Box d="grid" gridTemplateColumns="30% 70%" gap="12"> <Box> <Image src={$image('attrs.image', 'content')} w={100} maxW={100} style={{ objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "8px" }}></Image> </Box> <Box d="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="6" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}> <Box d="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center"> <Box as="strong" fontSize={5}>{$get('attrs.name')}</Box> <Badge bg={ $get('attrs.status') === 'available' ? 'success' : $get('attrs.status') === 'rented' ? 'warning' : $get('attrs.status') === 'maintenance' ? 'info' : 'secondary' }>{_t($get('attrs.status'))}</Badge> </Box> <Box color="secondary"> {$get('attrs.brand')} {$get('attrs.model')} · {$get('attrs.year')} </Box> <Box d="flex" alignItems="center"> <Box as={Icon} me={1} icon="card-text" />{$get('attrs.licensePlate')} </Box> <Box d="flex" flexWrap="wrap" gap="12"> <Box as="span" d="flex" alignItems="center"><Box as={Icon} me={1} icon="people-fill" />{$get('attrs.seats')}</Box> <Box as="span" d="flex" alignItems="center"><Box as={Icon} me={1} icon="fuel-pump-fill" />{$get('attrs.fuelType')}</Box> <Box as="span" d="flex" alignItems="center"><Box as={Icon} me={1} icon="gear-fill" />{$get('attrs.transmission')}</Box> <Box as="span" d="flex" alignItems="center"><Box as={Icon} me={1} icon="speedometer2" />{$get('attrs.mileage')} km</Box> </Box> <Box d="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mt={1} style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}> <Box color="secondary">{_t($get('attrs.category'))}</Box> <Box> <Box as="strong" color="primary">{$fmt('attrs.dailyRate')}</Box> <Box as="span" color="secondary">/day</Box> </Box> </Box> </Box> </Box> </>
